Issue 4540 -- control for the Compiler Explorer source transformation
generated by make-godbolt-transform-case.py; every command below was executed as shown

CE appends -Zi -Qembed_debug -Fc - to DXC panes, so those flags are used here too.

==============================================================================
### static kept
$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main -Zi -Qembed_debug repro.hlsl
  exit=0x00000000
  @storeTile = internal unnamed_addr addrspace(3) global i1 false
$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main -Zi -Qembed_debug godbolt-source.hlsl
  exit=0x00000000
  @storeTile = internal unnamed_addr addrspace(3) global i1 false
  -> untransformed and folded forms agree: YES

==============================================================================
### static removed (the known-good arm)
$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main -Zi -Qembed_debug control-no-static.hlsl
  exit=0x00000000
  @"\01?storeTile@@3IA" = external addrspace(3) global i32, align 4
$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main -Zi -Qembed_debug godbolt-source.hlsl -DNO_STATIC
  exit=0x00000000
  @"\01?storeTile@@3IA" = external addrspace(3) global i32, align 4
  -> untransformed and folded forms agree: YES

==============================================================================
pairs in agreement: 2/2

Both arms are checked on purpose. Confirming only the reproducing arm would
miss a guard that silently disabled the construct in the control.
